items.text: Open the command palette to run actions, add monsters and jump to an encounter
Keyboard shortcuts for damage, healing and conditions, with a target picker and an overview of every shortcut
Undo and redo changes to the initiative sheet from the command palette or with a shortcut
Apply area damage with saving throws to several creatures at once
Resistances, immunities and vulnerabilities are applied by damage type to attack rolls and hit point damage
Track monster resources like limited uses in the expanded row, with recharges rolled at the start of their turn
Ready an action and use it later
Hide a creature from the player portal and reveal it later
Players can mark their reaction as used from the player portal
The encounter difficulty is shown in the header, based on player levels and monster challenge ratings
Give players a level and homebrew monsters a challenge rating
The combat summary shows the XP each player earned for defeated monsters
The combat log records turn changes, dice rolls and creatures being added or removed
Export encounters and homebrew to a file and import them again
Import creatures from Improved Initiative, Kobold Fight Club and 5e.tools
Start a homebrew creature from an imported file
Monsters roll initiative automatically when they are added
Lair actions get initiative 20 automatically
Dead monsters are skipped when going to the next turn
Monsters keep their challenge rating on the initiative sheet
Damage, row edits and combat log updates sync faster with fewer requests
Icon buttons and the theme picker have labels for screen readers, and a skip to content link was added
Keyboard keys are easier to read
Ability modifiers stopped going up above a score of 20
Expanded rows closed when the encounter changed
Bestiary abilities that recharge on a roll had no usage limit
Players lost their own character and controls in the portal panel outside their turn
The player portal did not follow when the DM moved a player to another seat
The player portal went blank after a short connection hiccup
Players on the same wifi were rate limited together
The initiative sheet missed changes made while the connection was dropped
Changes made at the same time could reach the player portal out of order
Protected pages could open before your profile finished loading after signing in
